full_judgment: 2. The petitioner, as plaintiff, instituted the aforesaid suit praying for partition, stating inter alia, that the land described in the Schedule of the plaint was recorded in C.S. Khatian in the name of Ismail Sonar and Yousuf Sonar in an equal share. Ismail Sonar died leaving behind 3 sons and 3 daughters, Ainuddin alias Pacha Sheikh, one of the sons of Ismail Sonar, sold some portion of the land to the predecessor of the plaintiff on 20-3-1994 by executing deed of sale and thereafter the plaintiff petitioner and other co-sharers possessed the land in ejmali, Ainuddin died leaving behind one widow, 3 daughters, two brothers, and three sisters and Yousuf died leaving behind one widow, 4 sons and 5 daughters and all of them are in possession of the suit land in ejmali and since there are difficulties in possessing the land and the defendants refused to make partition amicably, the plaintiff petitioner was constrained to file the suit praying for partition.
